Sunita Ahuja Cries on Lock Upp 2 Set, Cites Poor Food

Sunita Ahuja, wife of actor Govinda, reportedly cried on the set of the reality show Lock Upp 2. She expressed distress over the food quality, describing it as unpleasant. Govinda had apparently advised her against participating in the show.
